title: No More Terrible Fps
description: A ModPack That Allows User To Get More Fps On Low End Pc. This Pack Includes both Fps boost And Utility Mods.
body:
A lightweight modpack focused on FPS boosts and essential utilities.
Built especially for low-end PCs, this pack improves performance, reduces lag, and adds useful quality-of-life features while keeping the game simple and stable. Ideal for smooth gameplay on weaker systems.
